description:
Controlled Checkbox State Bug

A recent refactor has broken the checkbox synchronization. The AgreementCheckbox component visually toggles, but it doesn't stay in sync with the checked prop from its parent.

Your Task:

  • Fix the component so that it behaves as a fully controlled component.
  • The checked prop should be the single source of truth.
  • onChange should be called with the correct next value.
  • Do not introduce internal state for the checked value.
